svg.aria-label: The 10c-dev build cycle. The implement skill on a ticket key moves the ticket to In Progress and opens Build, which holds the rung (R0 probe to R3 hardened), the interview with the developer, the tiny spec and writing the code. Verify runs it on the live app and fails back into step four. The diff is reviewed, then an optional critic drives the running app: FAIL returns to step four, PASS goes on, and the critic can be skipped. Commit and push happens only on your yes; the ticket waits on staging In Review until a human checks production — yes reaches Done, a bug opens a new ticket. Markers show which steps write outside the chat and which ask first.
svg.title: The 10c-dev build cycle
